title: Broad → Specific Ordering
description: The doc must move from the broad picture to specifics, SECTION BY SECTION: each section opens on the landscape — what the topic is and which types / kinds / parts / stages it has, named together in one place — and only then teaches them one at a time (what each is, where it came from, how it works, what it costs), finishing with the cross-cutting comparison and real use. A learner who meets the third kind of something before knowing there are four has to rebuild the map afterwards. The opening slide's ROLE is gated deterministically (it must be `overview` or `concept_intro`); this set judges whether that slide's CONTENT really sets the map, and whether the arc holds across the section.
criterion: Every section opens with the wide view (the set of types/parts named before any one is taught); detail deepens as the section progresses.

rubric.5: Clear broad→specific arc in every section; the set is named before its members are taught.
rubric.3: Mostly ordered, one slide out of place.
rubric.1: A section opens on a narrow detail, or types 1..N are taught without the set ever being named.

cases.rationale: Opens on a narrow formula before defining TCP — inverted order.

slides.title: The three scheduler levels
